summary: Petition under Sections 17(3) and 17(4) of the Electricity Act, 2003 for creation of security interest over all the movable and immovable assets of the Petitioner in favour of the Security Trustee, Respondent No. 2, for the benefit of the lender, Respondent No. 3. 2. The Petitioner has filed the present Petition under Section 17 of the Act seeking approval for creation of additional security interest over the Petitioner’s assets, including all movable and immovable assets, in favour of Respondent No. 2, Catalyst Trusteeship Limited (“Catalyst”/ “Security Trustee”) and for the benefit of Respondent No. 3, REC Limited (“REC”/ “Lender”) including its successors, transferees, novatees, and assigns for an additional amount of Rs. 387,37,00,000/- (Rupees Three Hundred Eighty-Seven Crores and Thirty-Seven Lakhs only). The Petitioner has made the following prayers: _b) approve the creation of the additional security interest by the Petitioner by way of hypothecation/ mortgage/ charge/ pledge/ assignment/hedging (as applicable) over all the Petitioner’s assets including the movable and immovable assets, Project accounts, Project documents (including the transmission license) etc. of the Petitioner in favour of Respondent No. 2/ Security Trustee (or its replacement or successor) for the benefit of the Lender under the Loan Agreement dated 21.12.2023, as amended by Amendment No. 1 dated 25.10.2024 and Amendment No. 2 dated 22.06.2026 (read with the other Financing Documents), in respect of the additional Cost Overrun Facility of INR 387.37 Crores;_ _c) approve the creation of additional Security Interest by way of hypothecation/ mortgage/ charge/ pledge/ assignment/hedging etc., over all the assets including the movable and immovable assets, Project accounts, Project documents (including the transmission license) etc. of the Petitioner in favour of_ _Respondent No. 2/ Security Trustee (or its replacement or successor) to secure the Petitioner’s obligations towards the Lender;_ _e) pass any such other relief as the Commission deems fit and appropriate in the facts and circumstances of the case.”_ (a) The Petitioner, in its capacity as a Transmission Service Provider, executed a Transmission Service Agreement (hereinafter referred to as ‘the TSA’) dated 20.9.2023 with the Central Transmission Utility Limited (hereinafter referred to as ‘Respondent No. 1/CTUIL’). Respondent No. 2, Catalyst Trusteeship Limited, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, is a Security Trustee for the benefit of the lender, and for its successors, subsequent transferees, assignees, novatees thereof, assigns and any refinancing and top up from existing as well as new lenders to the Project, and to enter into all relevant financing documents pursuant thereto. Respondent No. 3, REC Limited, i.e., the lender, is a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 1956. The Commission, _vide_ Order dated 25.6.2024 in Petition No. 166/MP/2024, had accorded the approval for the creation of security interest in favour of the Security Trustee. 4. The Petitioner has submitted that pursuant to the terms of the amended Loan Agreement (Clause 3.1), the Petitioner is required to create the necessary security interest in favour of Catalyst Trusteeship Limited, for the benefit of the lender, REC Limited, _inter alia,_ as follows: _(iv) first ranking charge by way of assignment in the form and manner acceptable to the Lenders;_ _(B) all the rights, title, interest, benefits, claims and demands whatsoever of the Borrower in the Clearances relating to the Project;_ _(D) all the rights, title, interest, benefits, claims and demands whatsoever of the Borrower in all Insurance contracts and Insurance Proceeds;_ 5. The Petitioner has submitted that the Petitioner is permitted to create encumbrances over its Project Assets only in accordance with the terms of the TSA and with necessary consents, including compliance with regulatory approvals as required under the applicable law. The financing structure, including execution of the Loan Agreement and Security Trustee Agreement, contemplates security creation that is consistent with the TSA framework and requires this Commission’s prior approval before creation of the charge. 7. Accordingly, the Petitioner has filed the present Petition seeking approval of the Commission for the creation of a Security over the Petitioner’s assets in favour of the Security Trustee acting for the benefit of the lender and its subsequent transferees, assignees, novatees thereof, by way of hypothecation/ assignment/ mortgage/ pledge/ guarantee, to the extent described in this Petition, to secure the additional facility aggregating to Rs 387.37 crore. 9. During the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that no reply has been filed by the Respondents despite notice. Upon consideration of the Petitioner's submissions, the matter was reserved for order. _15.2.1. Neither Party shall create or permit to subsist any encumbrance over all or any of its rights and benefits under this Agreement._ - _i. the Lenders or the Lenders' Representative on their behalf shall have entered into the Financing Agreements and agreed in writing to the provisions of this Agreement; and_ _“17. (3) No licensee shall any time assign his licence or transfer his utility, or any part thereof, by sale, lease, exchange or otherwise without the prior approval of the Appropriate Commission._ _(4) Any agreement relating to any transaction specified in sub-section (1) or sub-section (3), unless made with the prior approval of the Appropriate Commission, shall be void.”_
title: Petition under Sections 17(3) and 17(4) of the Electricity Act, 2003 for creation of security interest over all the movable and immovable assets of the Petitioner in favour of the Security Trustee, Respondent No. 2, for the benefit of the lender, Respondent No. 3.
